cold.definition: Five fresh Node processes; setup includes local hash verification, module/tokenizer/model load. Parent process wall time also includes Node startup, freeze verification and disposal. OS file caches were not flushed.

warm.definition: Ten consecutive audits reusing a loaded model after the reporting-set run; no warm observations discarded. Excludes model setup and process startup.

limitations: Author-constructed English synthetic labels; not a representative production sample or independent human annotation.
Ambiguous acceptance is a conservative review-policy violation and need not be a factual contradiction.
Only lexical gates were selected on twelve separate calibration cases; zero calibration errors does not imply zero future risk.
No customer feedback, willingness to pay, time savings, memory use or production accuracy measured.
